import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 93

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="aos_manager.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Add self-analysis pipeline function"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_92",
    metadata={"eval_id": 221}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
